description: Freight CO2e emissions by mode — Scope 3 freight transport emissions (GHG Protocol categories 4 and 9) using EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025 Table 8 factors per short ton-mile. Give weight (lb default; weightUnit=kg, t for tonnes, ton for short tons) and distance (miles; distanceUnit=km) to compare truck, rail, ocean and air side by side, or mode= for one mode, or legs=truck:300,ocean:4500,truck:50 for a multi-leg route. Returns ton-miles, CO2, CH4, N2O and CO2e (AR5 GWPs) per mode or leg, percent versus truck, the lowest-emission mode and totals. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_freight_emissions
